error_correction_rule: Report physical-qubit and syndrome/decoder overhead at the target logical error; logical gates alone are not a lifecycle cost.
readout_rule: Charge shots, destructive measurement, readout error mitigation, and tomography when full state information is claimed.
preparation_rule: Charge preparation circuit/depth/fidelity and discarded attempts; an input amplitude vector is not free.
claim_boundary: No capability or resource advantage follows without a matched known-quantum-algorithm baseline and measured end-to-end lifecycle frontier.
